newsitem.title: USA: American Toys becomes U.S. Wireless Corp.
newsitem.headline: American Toys becomes U.S. Wireless Corp.

text.p: U.S. Wireless Corp said it has changed its name from American Toys Inc., effective from October 21, and its stock now trades under the symbol "USWC."
"The change is attributable to the new focus and direction of the company into the wireless telecommunications field," the company said in a statement.
The company said its principal activity is the development of its digital radio front-end system for cellular and wireless base stations, following its spinoff of Play Co Toys & Entertainment Corp.
